summary.name: Reworkd
summary.one_liner: Reworkd is a documentation site for a tool that uses LLMs to parse, understand, and interact with web pages to scrape web data at scale.
use_cases: Scraping millions of rows of web data
Scraping a website and its sub pages
summary.what_it_does: The page is the introduction to Reworkd's documentation. It states that Reworkd uses LLMs to parse, understand, and interact with web pages in order to scrape web data at scale. It says customers use it to extract millions of rows of data. The docs navigation lists sections on key concepts, schemas, deduplication, exports (API and bulk), scheduling, templates, file downloads, API keys, and a scraping SDK. The page also notes that the same team built AgentGPT, which has its own GitHub project.
notable: Uses LLMs to parse and interact with web pages for scraping
Exports via API and bulk export options
Includes a scraping SDK and API reference
Built by the same team as AgentGPT
caveats: Pricing and plan details are not stated on this page
The page does not describe platform support beyond the web docs
